text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Connecting everyone... In that case, can 
my mom—I mean, the people 
who couldn't make it in person enjoy the 
parade too?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Abso-freakin'-lutely, Espon. 
Assuming we can pull it off, that is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, the whole reason this parade was on 
the brink of cancellation in the first 
place... Was that the gear didn't arrive, 
meaning we couldn't put on a proper show. 
And on top of that, attendance would drop 
big time, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Which means, rule number one: we can't 
leave behind the folks who can't come in 
person. An online livestream is a must.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, our win condition is 
pulling off a mind-blowing new stage 
effect. 
Something that lets the viewers at home 
have just as much fun as the crowd 
on-site.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yup! That's why we're gonna have the 
livestream viewers join in too! 
We'll set up tons of illuminations and let 
everyone control the light show together!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Bada-bing! Pop quiz for Espon. Having 
folks control the lights along to the 
parade music... Doesn't that ring a bell 
from somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Controlling along... to the 
music...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't tell me... A rhythm game?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong-ding-dong! Spot on♪ In other 
words, our key to victory is an 
illumination and stage tool that turns the 
parade into a massive rhythm game!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We sync a rhythm game beatmap to the 
phones and PCs of everyone watching the 
stream. 
Then, by linking that up with the 
illuminations set up across the event 
area—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No matter where you are, you can take part 
in the parade through the lights...! 
The performers and the fans, creating a 
one-of-a-kind parade together as one.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful if we can really 
pull it off! I'd love to help out too... 
Though, how exactly do you make a stage 
production tool like that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That custom rhythm game is freeware that 
volunteers all over the world are 
constantly tweaking day and night. 
There's a crazy amount of "wild pros" 
lurking in the community.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I floated the idea by them yesterday, and 
well...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A full-blown dev race for an external 
output tool kicked off instantly, 
and they said it should be ready by 
tomorrow♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Your connections are as insane as ever... 
But what about the song? Can we use the 
one we've been practicing?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that one doesn't have beatmap data 
for the game, so charting it from scratch 
would be a total pain in the butt~.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A song... a rhythm game... beatmap data... 
! ...Wait, don't we already have one?! 
That one song is perfect!

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Espo-san, was that the song from the 
game earlier?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Played it so much I memorized it 
even without sheet music.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we were all just messing around with 
that one for fun— 
...Actually, wait... could that work?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great, right? Right! 
That song already has beatmap data we can 
plug right into the rhythm game tool.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup☆ 
Then let's take this plan straight to the 
committee head and convince her!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"The Dreamy Night Parade Connecting 
Everyone." 
To put together such an extensive 
alternative proposal in just two days over 
the weekend...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As long as we get the preparations in 
order, we can make this a parade that even 
those who can't be here in person can 
enjoy to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If this works as intended, 
it will be profoundly meaningful as a Fan 
Thanksgiving parade.

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
And the concerns regarding audience 
attendance will be resolved. 
Am I correct in assuming that?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course☆ Our reliable Tran-san has 
taken charge of that part♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes to set up an 
environment on the Academy side that can 
handle inputs from thousands... no, tens 
of thousands of people at once—so I'll 
leave the rest to you guys~

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. However, one issue still 
remains. 
We still lack the crucial element to bring 
the fans' feelings to light—the lights 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
The parade route is vast. Without the 
specialized lighting we originally planned 
for, 
how do you intend to secure enough 
illumination equipment to cover that 
entire area—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! 
We've already got some leads on that too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We can borrow spare illumination lights 
from racetracks we've worked with before! 
That will cover about sixty percent of 
what we need!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Sixty percent... That is rather 
precarious.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're negotiating with event companies 
we've met through live shows too! 
We promise we'll scrape together the rest, 
no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because if we give up, we won't be able to 
make anyone happy! 
And besides—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...If we don't reach our hands out right 
now, we might miss the chance to take 
someone else's forever. 
That's why we want to do this now!"

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"...The absolute deadline for preparations 
is the end of the day before tomorrow. 
We have PR deadlines to consider. Until 
then, I will put the cancellation on 
hold."

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"I will also submit the special 
authorization request to the Chairwoman 
for the staging tools. 
...Best of luck."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!
